transcript: When we turn 18, we wish we took up sports earlier. When we turn 25, we wish we tried harder in school. When we turn 35, we wish we started that business. And when we turn 40, we wish our life away. The truth is, the best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is today.
